name: AhnLab, Inc.
summary: AhnLab, Inc. provides information security solutions and services for consumers, enterprises, and small and medium businesses worldwide. It offers AhnLab AI PLUS, an AI security platform; AhnLab V3, a set of anti-malware products that protect desktops, laptops and servers; AhnLab EPP which unifies modern endpoint security tools across anti-malware, security assessment, patch management, personal data protection, and endpoint detection and response; AhnLab MDS, a sandbox solution that provides advanced threat detection, analysis and response capabilities; AhnLab EDR that detects advanced threats through behavioral analysis, AI-driven investigation, and proactive threat hunting; AhnLab Office …
